- Tools: discover_services, invoke_and_pay, get_receipt
- GitHub: https://github.com/SynapseNetworkAI/Synapse-Network-MCP-Server

submission_payload.short_description: Synapse Network Remote MCP lets AI agents discover payable APIs, invoke approved paid tools with bounded USDC spend, and retrieve receipts.
submission_payload.submission_method: Email support@aitoolnet.com from the Synapse support mailbox.
submission_payload.email_body:
Hello AIToolNet team,

Please review SynapseNetwork MCP Server for an AIToolNet listing.

Website: https://www.synapse-network.ai/
GitHub: https://github.com/SynapseNetworkAI/Synapse-Network-MCP-Server
npm: @synapse-network-ai/mcp-server
Remote MCP endpoint: https://mcp.synapse-network.ai/mcp
Category: AI agents / Developer tools / Payments
Tools: discover_services, invoke_and_pay, get_receipt

Short description: Remote MCP for paid API discovery, API invocation, USDC agent payments, and receipts.

Thanks,
Synapse Network
submission_payload.pricing_or_plan: Free review queue; paid fast-track requires explicit operator approval.
submission_payload.listing_content: Synapse Network MCP Server is a Remote MCP endpoint for AI agents to discover callable APIs, invoke paid services with spend controls, and retrieve receipts. Remote endpoint: https://mcp.synapse-network.ai/mcp. GitHub: https://github.com/SynapseNetworkAI/Synapse-Network-MCP-Server. npm: @synapse-network-ai/mcp-server. Tools: discover_services, invoke_and_pay, get_receipt. Docs: https://docs.synapse-network.ai/mcp.
submission_payload.contact_email_notes: Operator-owned email only; required by the AIToolNet form. Use a Synapse contact email; do not use API keys, bearer tokens, or personal secret values.
submission_payload.submission_blocker: AIToolNet submission requires an operator email send/draft receipt or browser confirmation. Do not mark submitted until that evidence exists.
acceptance_terms: MCP server for paid API calls
ChatGPT MCP app for API payments
